title: Review of c27's SIBRM ringswim repair: repair replicates on fresh seeds 21 and 22 (6/6 front cuts regain area with the ring held, links-only erasure lethal 6/6); M is the label drive (by construction) and only 1 of 6 repaired cells swims >= 3 body lengths
summary: Re-ran the claimed world unchanged: a labkit pack on fresh seed 21 (280 frames, --damage 200:0.4:half) and c27's twinrepair.py (T0=10000, 3 cells, 2000 steps, exact branched twins) on fresh seeds 21 and 22. Front cuts of 40% (41-45% of links): 6/6 cut cells regain their pre-cut area (+180 to +580) and hold the link ring >= 1.5 in 96-100% of later samples; closure goes from 0.48-0.69 to >= 0.9 by +40-100 in 4/6 (one at +880, one stays near 0.8-0.9). Links-only erasure kills 6/6 cells within 60-80 steps. Labkit's own cut on seed 21 hit an elongated non-mature cell (fallback-largest) that merged at +50, so the labkit damage panel is not informative; its radial profile confirms the ring (L rim/core 1.67, rim/out 6.7; 141/174 individuals membrane-like). After repair, seed 22 cell 4 swims 4.65 body lengths (twin 4.15); the other five travel 0.25-2.4 (twins 0.3-2.2).

observations.B: rerun/radial.png: L link rim/core 1.67, rim/outside 6.68, 141/174 individuals membrane-like; links are made by the cell's own gated catalyst (prodL = b K S, K held by phi^2 mobility), so the chi drift up 4phi(1-phi) collects a self-made species (RUBRIC L3 quasi-equilibrium clause)
observations.R: tr21/twinrepair.png and tr22/twinrepair.png: 6/6 front-cut cells regain pre-cut area at +180-580 with ring >= 1.5 in 96-100% of later samples, exact undamaged twins alongside; links-only erasure kills 6/6 at +60-80

seeds_run.result: pass: labkit pack; twinrepair 3/3 front cuts repair (closure >= 0.9 at +40-60, area back +180-260), links-only 3/3 die

pass for R: 3/3 front cuts regain area (+260-580); closure >= 0.9 at +100 in 1/3, +880 in 1/3 (that cell then lost at +900 near its twin's division), never in 1/3 though ring >= 1.5; links-only 3/3 die

controls_run.R: exact branched undamaged twin per cut and links-only erasure arm (tr21/, tr22/)

verdicts.limitation: M: world.py uses drive='label' (line 68), a rigid per-body drift computed from connected-component labels (drive_velocity), so motility is imposed by the code; and only 1 of 6 repaired cells on my seeds (seed 22 cell 4, 4.65 BL) reaches 3 body lengths before a split, merge or loss. Wall smoothing is curvature flow plus tilt (by construction); what the dynamics add is remaking links fast enough. The claim's rule that every cell with closure >= 0.30 repairs is not exact: seed 22 cell 32 (closure 0.48) regained area but reached closure 0.9 only at +880 and was lost at +900. 256^2 only; no resolution or dt/2 test by me.
